# Plasticine generation prompts

One full-bleed 9:16 illustration per canonical scene; shared aliases keep compatible filenames.

## bakery-fresh-batch_oven
Status: approved. Canonical: `bakery-fresh-batch_oven`.

EXACT SCENE: Fresh batch / Out of the oven.
REQUIRED PICTURE: A baker presents a hot tray of freshly baked croissants at the customer-facing display counter; the tray and steam are clearly visible. Film from the public customer side, not inside the oven room.
CAMERA: MEDIUM shot through the visitor camera at the actual named subject/action plus useful context. No foreground narrator or person filming.
ANGLE: eye-level, level horizon; starting framing medium.
CONTINUITY: Same golden chocolate-filled clay croissant throughout, whole for tray/pick, opened only for inside/detail. Same yellow/sage public bakery.
Everything in this scene is unmistakably hand-moulded PLASTICINE, like a premium stop-motion miniature. The WORLD must NEVER be more realistic than the characters. Broad rounded solid clay masses, matte finish, simple sculpted edges, gentle warm lighting and soft ambient occlusion. Sunny yellow accents, sage/teal, dusty pink, warm cream, charcoal and warm brown. Hair is visibly unnatural solid plasticine: a few thick sculpted locks/locs and broad grooves, NO individual hairs, fuzz or stubble. Any food explicitly required by this scene is made of simple broad clay shapes, no realistic food texture, crumbs or pores. Surfaces have no photographic microdetail: no fabric weave, wood grain, skin pores, chrome metal, leaf veins or realistic liquid. Equally simplified clay people, food, furniture and architecture.
Same established cast when needed: CREATOR is the saved tan woman with dark-brown moulded ponytail, yellow shirt, sage trousers and dusty-pink bag on her anatomical RIGHT hip. BARISTA identity is the saved young-looking light-medium man with short swept dark-brown moulded locks; apron only for cafe/bakery work, appropriate workwear elsewhere. FRIEND_LOCS is the saved youthful Black male with short chunky outward clay locs, ivory tee, sage trousers; preserve accepted face/age. Do not add a character unless the scene requires one. Do not copy reference poses or environments.
Single full-bleed 9:16 portrait, one useful instant of the specified shot. At most TWO visible attached hands TOTAL, including background and partial hands; hide/crop others. Natural hands and coherent support/contact between objects. The camera is in visitor-accessible space, never a restricted kitchen, staff counter or workbench. No photographed filming phone/camera: words 'phone', 'back camera' and 'selfie' describe viewpoint only; only show a handset when it is the explicitly named repair subject. No text, pseudolettering, letters, numbers, logos, UI, arrows, borders, panels or watermark. Blank menus/receipts and simple pictograms only. Personal food plates at usable off-centre diner place settings, never in table centre. Exact scene/camera/action beats any reference pose or props.
The input is a MATERIAL/STYLE reference only, or a recurring character reference if this scene explicitly calls for that person. Do not copy its pose, camera angle, coffee, cup or cafe into another subject. Follow the hard camera requirements at the beginning of this prompt. Do NOT insert a foreground narrator or a cafe patron into an empty room or a first-person POV scene.

Coffee is a smooth brown clay disk with a few broad cream clay milk-art shapes, not real bubbles or foam microtexture; pouring milk/espresso is a simple coherent clay ribbon connecting its real source to the receiving cup. Pasta is a few thick clay noodles with simple red tomato and green leaf shapes, no grated-cheese particles or realistic sauce texture. Fruit is smooth colored clay with no skin/seeds/fuzz. Glass/drinks use simple soft translucent plastic/clay forms and a few chunky ice pieces, not optical liquid simulation. Tables and shelves are plain warm-brown clay, no wood grain. Machines are rounded gray/charcoal clay, no real chrome, steel brushing or intricate reflections. Plants have a few thick sculpted leaves, no veins. Walls/tiles are broad smooth clay forms, no stone, brick, paint or terrazzo microtexture. Sunny yellow accents, sage/teal, dusty pink, warm cream/off-white, charcoal and warm brown throughout. Match the provided plasticine cafe master, not realistic food photography or a realistic room with cartoon people composited into it.
